title: Crossed Homomorphisms on associative superalgebras
summary: In this paper, we introduce the notion of crossed homomorphisms on associative superalgebras. We show that crossed homomorphisms are precisely the Maurer--Cartan elements of a naturally associated graded Lie algebra. This characterization enables us to construct a cohomology theory of crossed homomorphisms. We then investigate formal deformations of crossed homomorphisms and derive the corresponding deformation equations.
